args: Money is stored as integer cents in src/lib/money.ts; never use floats.
All timestamps are stored in UTC and formatted only at the API edge.
Order ids are ULIDs generated in src/lib/ids.ts.
Background work goes through the Redis queue in src/worker/queue.ts.
Logs are JSON lines written by src/lib/logger.ts; never log request bodies.
API errors are returned as {error: {code, message}} from src/api/errors.ts.
Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Database migrations are plain SQL files in src/db/migrations, numbered in order.
